cta.owners_link: Run a bar or restaurant? See how the bill adds up

hero.title: Every table closes with the right bill.
hero.lead: Table4All puts QR ordering, the kitchen queue and split payments on a single tab. Owners know exactly what came in. Guests order without waiting for a waiter.

steps.label: One night at a table, from first order to closing

order.title: Guests order from their phone
order.body: Every table has a QR code. Whoever sits down scans it, sees the menu with photos and prices, and sends the order. No flagging down the waiter, no orders taken down wrong.

queue.title: Every order goes to the right queue
queue.body: Draft beer lands in the bar queue, appetizers in the kitchen queue. Whoever prepares marks it ready, whoever serves marks it delivered. Items with no prep go straight to delivery.

price.title: The price is locked when the order is placed
price.body: Happy hour or date-based promotions apply the moment an item is ordered. Happy hour ended at 8 pm, but the beer ordered at 7:42 keeps its promo price. Changed the menu later? The table's bill stays the same.

payments.title: Split the bill, no calculator
payments.body: Everyone pays their share by Pix, card, cash or coupon. The tab shows what has been paid and what is left, and guests see the same number on their phone.

close.title: A table only closes when the bill adds up
close.body: A table can only be closed once payments cover the total. Every closed bill feeds the dashboard: revenue per day, best sellers, average ticket per table and payment methods.

owners.title: For whoever runs the venue
items: Tables, waiters and menus in one place
Separate prep queues for the kitchen, the bar and anything else
Promotions by weekday and time, or by date
Dashboard with revenue, best sellers and payment methods
Print-ready menus with a QR code

guests.title: For whoever sits at the table
items: Scan the QR and you are at the table
Order at your own pace, no hand-raising
Follow what is being prepared and what has arrived
See the total, what has been paid and what each person owes

closing.title: There's a table open tonight.
closing.body: Create an account to order by QR, or log in to run your venue.
